item.title: 747 Help to Buy claims approved for Kerry
item.description: 747 Help to Buy Incentive claims have been approved for the county since its introduction in 2017, to the amount of €15.5 million. The Help to Buy Incentive was announced in Budget 2017, and was available from January 1st 2017 to December 31st 2024. The incentive was designed to assist first time buyers with the deposit required to purchase a self build or new house or apartment to live in as their home. item.title: Gardaí appealing for information regarding stolen defibrillator in South Kerry
item.description: Gardaí are appealing for information after a defibrillator was stolen in South Kerry. The defibrillator was taken from Dromore Sportsfield in Blackwater at some point between the 5th and the 12th of December. Gardaí are seeking anyone who witnessed suspicious behaviour around the area between those dates. item.title: Kerry farmers express concern at Chinese authorities' decision to impose duties on EU dairy imports
item.description: Kerry farmers have expressed their concern at the decision by Chinese authorities to impose duties on EU dairy imports. The decision has the potential to impact Irish farming families at a time where dairy markets around the world are struggling. China is an important market for both EU and Irish dairy. item.title: Evans secures place in third round of World Championship
item.description: Ricky Evans has secured his place in the third round of the PDC World Darts Championship. Evans beat World number 7, James Wade in dramatic fashion 6-4 at the Alexandra Palace. Earlier today The Netherlands' Kevin Doets beat W-D-C newcomer Kenya's David Munyua (PRO: Mun-You-A) in three straight sets. item.title: Zambia and Mali draw
item.description: Zambia managed to rescue a point in their clash with Mali in the Africa Cup of Nations. A 92nd minute goal from Leicester City forward Patson Daka ensured they came away with a draw in a fixture that saw Mali miss a penalty in the first-half. Mo Salah is set to feature for Egypt later. Advertisement They go up against Zimbabwe in Morocco, with kick off at 8pm.

item.title: Frawley set to join Connacht
item.description: Ciarán Frawley is set to join Connacht from Leinster next summer ahead of the 2026-27 campaign. The Skerries native had spent nine seasons at his native province. He'll now join up with Stuart Lancaster, who coached him for six seasons at Leinster. Advertisement
